COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS 
 WPMS No. 1360 of 2021 
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J. 
Mr. Akhil Kumar Sah, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Rakesh Kunwar, Addl. C.S.C. for the 
State. 
Heard learned counsel for the parties 
through video conferencing. 
Learned State Counsel was asked to get 
necessary instructions. Today, Mr. Rakesh 
Kunwar, Addl. C.S.C. has made a statement 
that petitioner has been referred for treatment 
to AIIMS, Rishikesh and he has been shifted 
from Haldwani to Rishikesh on 20.07.2021. 
In view of the above, petitioner is 
permitted to implead All India Institute of 
Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Rishikesh, District 
Dehradun, through its Director as respondent 
no.4. 
Amended memo of parties be filed 
during the course of the day. 
Respondent no.4 be served through its 
local counsel. 
Put up on 24.07.2021. 
 
 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 22.07.2021
Rajni

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No. 1360 of 2021
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Akhil Kumar Sah, learned counsel 
for the petitoner. 
Mr. Vinod Nautiyal, learne Deputy 
Advocate General for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
In sequel to the order dated 
27.07.2021, Mr. A.P. Anshuman – Inspector 
General of Prisons is present through video 
conference. He makes a statement that 
petitioner has been shifted to AIIMS, 
Rishikesh, where ophthalmologist had
checked his eyes and given appropriate
treatment to him. He further submits that 
petitioner is presently admitted in AIIMS, 
Rishikesh for treatment under the 
supervision of Dr. R.S. Mittal, 
Neurosurgeon. He assures the Court that 
all possible treatment would be given to the 
petitioner. 
Personal presence of the Inspector 
General of Prisons is dispensed with. 
List this matter after four weeks. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 29.07.2021
Aswal
